title: Casualists' Custom Recipes
description: The custom datapack that adds the new or changed recipes for the private Casualists SMP.
body:
Hi there, welcome to the OFFICIAL _Casualists' Custom Recipes_ datapack.
Don't worry, there's nothing original to this, it's literally just another datapack full with random QoL recipes.

Here's some recipes for example:
- An easier TNT recipe. (paying some homage to the Life Series lol)
- A more difficult Eye of Ender recipe, transforming its usage to purely a progression gate that finally connects Minecraft's horizontal progression (At least, some of it. I admit it could've been done better, way better.)
  - Don't worry, we made sure that other items using eyes of ender as a recipe ingredient had their recipes changed for balancing purposes.
- Shapeless recipes for certain items such as bread (I repeat, they are not crossaints.), paper and shulker boxes.
- Recipes for Powered Rails that can use both the original gold, and now copper as well.
- Anddddd more... (I'm an incredibly lazy fellow and I'm not saying more.)

CHECK GALLERY FOR ALL RECIPES AND THEIR CORRESPONDING IMAGES.

Alright then, have a nice day. (a nicer day if you download and use the datapack :D)
